title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Ultra Romantic 3rd Season Teaser PV - Ishigami Yuu wa Kataritai
justification: AniList 165557 (ONA, 1 episode(s) from 2021-10-21) is AniDB 15806's special(s) S1, aired 2021-10-21. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 125367, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 15806, and the special's title (Ishigami Yuu wa Kataritai) matches an AniList title. The parent's node, as overlay/15806.json patches it, places S1 on TVDB 0x2 Yu Ishigami Wants to Chat, 2021-10-20. TMDB 83121, where the parent's node places the special(s) through the overlay's TMDB rows, agrees: S0E3 Yu Ishigami Wants to Chat 2021-10-21.
